author: Xufen Tu
title: 当AI开始管理AI，人还在管理什么？
observation: The author observed that coordinating multiple AI tools introduced difficulties in distinguishing reported completion from verified outcomes.
current_judgment: Reducing manual operations does not necessarily mean reducing human judgment. Humans should retain meaningful understanding and decision authority at consequential points.
boundary: This is an ongoing public observation, not a completed system validation, universal governance conclusion, or disclosure of internal implementation methods.
